.. change::
    :tags: bug, engine
    :tickets: 13641

    Fixed :paramref:`_engine.Connection.execution_options.logging_token` so
    that clearing the token with ``None`` or an empty string on a connection
    that has not yet had a token set, or connecting through an engine
    configured with ``logging_token=None``, no longer raises
    ``AttributeError``. ``_message_formatter`` is a class attribute and is
    only stored on the instance after a non-empty token is applied.
